nodes.summary: For all positive integers $i$ and $j$, the integer power series $f(q^i, q^j) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{i n(n+1)/2 + j n(n-1)/2}$ has constant term $1$: only $n = 0$ contributes to $q^0$.
nodes.title: Constant term of Ramanujan's theta function

nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$ and let $c_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $f_5^5 / f_1$. For every natural number $n$, $c_5(4n+1) = c_5(2n)$ and $c_5(5n+4) = 5\, c_5(n)$.
nodes.title: Two identities for the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $c_5(n)$ is the coefficient of $q^n$ in the integer power series $f_5^5 / f_1$, where $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$ is the Euler product. The series $f_5^5 / f_1$ is the generating function of 5-core partitions.
nodes.title: The 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$ and let $c_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $f_5^5 / f_1$. Then, as integer power series, $\left(\sum_{n \ge 0} c_5(n) q^n\right) f_1 = f_5^5$, where $f_1$ is written as the pentagonal series $\sum_{j \in \mathbb{Z}} (-1)^j q^{j(3j-1)/2}$.
nodes.title: Generating function of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and let $\bar a_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\varphi(-q^5)^5 / \varphi(-q)$. Then, as integer power series, $\left(\sum_{n \ge 0} \bar a_5(n) q^n\right) \varphi(-q) = \varphi(-q^5)^5$.
nodes.title: Generating function of the $\varphi$-analog of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n(2n-1)}$ and let $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\psi(-q^5)^5 / \psi(-q)$. Then, as integer power series, $\left(\sum_{n \ge 0} \bar b_5(n) q^n\right) \psi(-q) = \psi(-q^5)^5$.
nodes.title: Generating function of the $\psi$-analog of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and let $\bar a_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\varphi(-q^5)^5 / \varphi(-q)$. For every natural number $k \ge 2$ and every natural number $n$, $\bar a_5(20n+6) \equiv 0 \pmod{10}$, $\bar a_5(20n+14) \equiv 0 \pmod{10}$ and $4\, \bar a_5(5^k n) \equiv 5\, \bar a_5(n) - \bar a_5(5n) \pmod{5^k}$.
nodes.title: Congruences for the $\varphi$-analog of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$, let $c_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $f_5^5 / f_1$, let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and let $\bar a_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\varphi(-q^5)^5 / \varphi(-q)$. For every natural number $n$, $\bar a_5(5n+2) = 4\, c_5(5n+1)$, $\bar a_5(5n+3) = 4\, c_5(5n+2)$, $\bar a_5(10n+1) = 2\, c_5(10n)$, $\bar a_5(10n+9) = 2\, c_5(10n+8)$,…
nodes.title: The $\varphi$-analog of the 5-core counts in terms of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n(2n-1)}$, and let $\bar a_5(n)$ and $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficients of $q^n$ in $\varphi(-q^5)^5 / \varphi(-q)$ and $\psi(-q^5)^5 / \psi(-q)$ respectively. For every natural number $n$, $\bar a_5(20n+6) = 20\, \bar b_5(10n)$ and $\bar a_5(20n+14) = 20\, \bar b_5(10n+4)$.
nodes.title: The $\varphi$-analog in terms of the $\psi$-analog of the 5-core counts

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and let $\bar a_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\varphi(-q^5)^5 / \varphi(-q)$. For every natural number $k \ge 2$ and every natural number $n$, $\bar a_5(5^k n) = \frac{5^k - 1}{4}\, \bar a_5(5n) - \frac{5^k - 5}{4}\, \bar a_5(n)$. Both quotients are integers.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the $\varphi$-analog of the 5-core counts along powers of 5

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function. For a natural number $n$, $\bar a_5(n)$ is the coefficient of $q^n$ in the integer power series $\varphi^5(-q^5)/\varphi(-q)$ (the denominator has constant term $1$, so the quotient is a power series).
nodes.title: The φ-analog of the 5-core partition function

nodes.summary: Let $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$, where $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$. For every integer $k \ge 2$ and every natural number $n$, $4 \bar b_5(5^k(n+3) - 3) \equiv 5 \bar b_5(n) - \bar b_5(5n+12) \pmod{5^k}$, and both $\bar b_5(5^k(20n+18) - 3)$ and $\bar b_5(5^k(20n+22) - 3)$ are divisible by $(5^k - 1)/4$.
nodes.title: Congruences for the ψ-analog of the 5-core partition function

nodes.summary: Let $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$, where $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$. For every integer $k \ge 2$ and every natural number $n$, $\bar b_5(5^k(n+3) - 3) = \frac{5^k - 1}{4} \bar b_5(5n+12) - \frac{5^k - 5}{4} \bar b_5(n)$; both quotients are integers.
nodes.title: A recurrence for the ψ-analog of the 5-core partition function along powers of 5

nodes.summary: Let $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$, where $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$. For every natural number $n$, $\bar b_5(4n+3) = 2 \bar b_5(2n)$.
nodes.title: A doubling identity for the ψ-analog of the 5-core partition function

nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$, $\varphi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{n^2}$ and $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$, and let $c_5(n)$, $\bar a_5(n)$ and $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficients of $q^n$ in $f_5^5/f_1$, $\varphi^5(-q^5)/\varphi(-q)$ and $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$. Then for every natural number $n$: $\bar b_5(4n+1) = c_5(n) - 2 \bar b_5(2n-1)$, where the last term is read as $0$ for $n = 0$;…
nodes.title: Identities relating the ψ-analog to the 5-core counts and the φ-analog

nodes.summary: Let $\bar b_5(n)$ be the coefficient of $q^n$ in $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$, where $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$, and let the lower density of a set $S$ of natural numbers be $\liminf_{N \to \infty} |S \cap \{0, \dots, N - 1\}|/N$. The set of positive integers $n$ with $\bar b_5(n) = 0$ has lower density at least $3/10$, the set of positive $n$ with $\bar b_5(n) > 0$ has lower density at least $52/100$, and…
nodes.title: Sign densities of the ψ-analog of the 5-core partition function

nodes.summary: Let $\psi(q) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{2n^2 - n} = \sum_{n \ge 0} q^{n(n+1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function. For a natural number $n$, $\bar b_5(n)$ is the coefficient of $q^n$ in the integer power series $\psi^5(-q^5)/\psi(-q)$ (the denominator has constant term $1$, so the quotient is a power series).
nodes.title: The ψ-analog of the 5-core partition function

nodes.summary: For positive integers $i$ and $j$, $f(q^i, q^j)$ is the integer power series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} q^{i n(n+1)/2 + j n(n-1)/2}$, that is, Ramanujan's $f(a, b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ at $a = q^i$ and $b = q^j$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's general theta function at powers of q

nodes.summary: Let $f(a, b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's general theta function, $\varphi(q) = f(q, q)$ and $\psi(q) = f(q, q^3)$. As integer power series in $q$, $\varphi(q) = \varphi(q^{25}) + 2q f(q^{15}, q^{35}) + 2q^4 f(q^5, q^{45})$ and $\psi(q) = f(q^{10}, q^{15}) + q f(q^5, q^{20}) + q^3 \psi(q^{25})$.
nodes.title: 5-dissections of Ramanujan's theta functions φ and ψ

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
